body.name: explicit Poisson--Gaussian no-breakout witness
body.construction: Fix \(E\ge d+1\) and positive \(q,L,\eta,\sigma_t^2,\sigma_y^2\) such that \(a_0+\rho\le1\le a_1-\rho\), \(q_0+\rho\le q\le q_1-\rho\), and \(q/2\le B-\rho\).  Let \(\lambda_{0,j}=L\) and \(\lambda_{e,j}=L+\eta\mathbf 1\{e=j\}\) for \(j=1,\ldots,d\), with all environments \(e>d\) at the baseline intensities, and take independent \(N_{e,j}\sim\operatorname{Poisson}(\lambda_{e,j})\).  Set \(\epsilon_{u,e}=\sum_{j=1}^d j(N_{e,j}-\lambda_{e,j})\), let every \(\epsilon_{t,e}\) have the common law \(\mathcal N(0,\sigma_t^2)\), take \(\epsilon_y\sim\mathcal N(0,\sigma_y^2)\), and make these sources mutually independent.  Set \(\alpha=1\), \(\beta=-q/2\), and \(\gamma=q\).  Require \(\eta\sigma_d(V_d)\ge\kappa_0+\rho\) and \[\max\left\{\max_{e\in\mathcal E}\mathbb E\left|\sum_{j=1}^d j(N_{e,j}-\lambda_{e,j})\right|^{2R_{\max}+\delta},\ \mathbb E|\epsilon_{t,0}|^{2R_{\max}+\delta},\ \mathbb E|\epsilon_y|^{2R_{\max}+\delta}\right\}\le M-\rho.\]
